data.name: Leap of Legends
data.detailed_description:
Hop. Bounce. Race. Together.

Leap of Legends is a cheerful 2D platformer where animal pals leap across colorful worlds in friendly multiplayer matches and solo adventures. Easy to learn, tricky to
master — and free to play on every device. Pick your critter, stack on hats and skins, and bounce into matches with friends across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.

Play anywhere. With anyone.
True cross-play. Your friend on a phone, your sibling on a tablet, you on the couch with a controller — everyone shares the same match. No accounts to juggle, no sign-up
walls.

Multiplayer, your way
  • Online matchmaking — public lobbies, friend invites, or instant random matches. Cross-platform lobbies, smart skill matching, and a 60-second drop-back-in
    window if your connection hiccups.
  • Local couch play — 2 to 4 players on one screen. Mix keyboard, mouse, controllers, and touch. AI bots fill any empty slots. No internet needed.
  • Solo adventures — practice modes, endless runs with leaderboards, and a cosmetic chest after every match. 100% playable offline.

A new game mode every match
Built-in classics keep things fresh, plus community mods on Steam Workshop:
  • Tag Match — hop after your friends and bonk them on the head.
  • Gold Rush — sprint and leap to snatch coins before the timer drops.
  • Capture the Flag — red vs blue, steal the enemy flag, and pull off team plays.
  • Crossfire — press the big green button to call down the strike. A friendly tribute to a legend.
New official mods land monthly, free on every platform.



Countless animals, hats & skins
Frog, fox, duck, crocodile, otter, and many more on the way — 50+ animals, 200+ hats, and endless combos. Earn cosmetic chests just by playing. No pay-to-win, ever.

Built for families
Leap of Legends is designed from day one for kids and families — no blood, no weapons, no stranger chat. Just colorful animal characters bouncing through cheerful worlds.
  • No ads, ever
  • No third-party tracking
  • Voice and text chat off for child accounts
  • A one-time date-of-birth check applies the right protections automatically
Compliant with Steam Family-Friendly, Apple Kids Category, and Google Play Designed for Families guidelines.

Ready to leap in?
Available now on Steam for Windows and macOS, with iOS and Android on the way. Free to play. Designed for families. Cross-platform multiplayer.
